message.content:
**profedcreditunion.com** appears to be the website for **ProFed Credit Union**, but the search results show the credit union’s current official domain as **profedcu.org** rather than profedcreditunion.com.[2][3]

If you meant the credit union itself, here are the most relevant details:
- **ProFed Credit Union** is based in Fort Wayne, Indiana.[1][2]
- It serves members in nine northeast Indiana counties and has **13 branch locations**.[2][3]
- Its member support phone number is **260-373-1633**, and the support email shown is **contactus@profedcu.org**.[1][7]
- You can join if you live, work, worship, attend school, volunteer, or regularly conduct business in the eligible counties listed on its site.[2][4]

If you want, I can also help you verify whether **www.profedcreditunion.com** is an active site or a typo for **profedcu.org**.
